not_applicable_features.dual_class: Single class of common stock, one vote per share (Description of Capital Stock). Founder control is via concentrated single-class ownership, not a dual-class structure.

not_applicable_features.pe_sponsor_control: Controlled by founder David D. Halbert (56.7% pre / 44.6% post), not a PE sponsor. Sixth Street 11.2% and J.H. Whitney 9.3% are minority financial holders.
not_applicable_features.common_control_merger: No common-control combination / carve-out accounting disclosed; single operating segment organic build.
not_applicable_features.pe_dividend_recap: No pre-IPO dividend recap; company is cash-burning with going-concern doubt. 2023 Term Loan ($400M) is growth/operating debt, not a recap distribution.
